long_biography.plain_text:
Kliniki Kastalia's corporate vehicle dates to 1972 and was established to provide care for psychiatric and neurological conditions. Its remit extended beyond inpatient treatment to rehabilitation, mental-health research, specialist training and collaboration with academic institutions. Petros Lymperis took responsibility for the organisation in the early 1990s and represented it as both a medical professional and business leader.

His clinical perspective also entered professional discussions about the structure of private mental-health care. At a conference organised in collaboration with the World Psychiatric Association, Lymperis spoke on private psychiatric provision and differences in patient access. The programme identified him as Kastalia's psychiatrist-director in Athens, joining his medical identity to the management of a specialised institution.

uncertainties.detail: A younger Petros Lymperis studied chemical engineering at Newcastle University and is excluded by generation, geography and occupation. The Greek media company belongs to Antonios Lymperis, while exact-name shipping searches did not establish a separate Petros Lymperis shipping principal. The psychiatrist-director is the only candidate matching the full owner context.

Established reporting says psychiatrist Nikos Lymperis founded Kastalia in 1966 and that his son Petros inherited and took over its management in the early 1990s. The Athens Chamber dates the present corporate vehicle to 1972. The dossier distinguishes the earlier clinic foundation from the later company date and does not credit Petros with founding the inherited platform.

Healthcare is the only principal private-business sector tied to Lymperis, but the chamber now records the company under liquidation and current day-to-day operations are not independently clear. Healthcare is retained at 85 confidence rather than implying an active operating scale.

Historical reporting gives ages consistent with approximately 1950 but does not resolve the year or full date precisely enough for import. The N.P. initials in the clinic's legal name reflect the family company naming and are not treated as evidence of Petros's middle names.

The visible LinkedIn profile belongs to the younger Newcastle engineer, and the name-only X account provides no corroborating identity detail. No personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X or personal website met the identity threshold.
The chamber record lists castaliaclinic.gr, but the site was inaccessible and the company is under liquidation. No Company Website proposal is made.
Both biographies and all classifications omit vessel facts, politics, legal matters, allegations, controversies, sensitive personal information, wealth estimates and transient operating figures.

review.notes: Petros Lymperis is terminally resolved as the Greek psychiatrist and second-generation Kastalia clinic operator. The dossier distinguishes his inherited ownership and management from father Nikos Lymperis's founding role, and excludes the media and younger engineering namesakes. Current healthcare activity is classified cautiously because the company registry records liquidation. Nothing has been compiled or applied to the owner record or live system.
